description: Find Seacoast ME–NH and Casco Bay boatyards, marinas and storage (public-web listings, not partners). Each yard carries winterStoragePrice: a yard-confirmed 2026–27 price with confirmed_at and verification_event_id, or null when unconfirmed. Set confirmed=true for confirmed yards only. Human-readable index: /yards. For posted prices see get_seacoast_costs and /guides/winter-storage-haul-out-seacoast; for ramps and tides see /guides/seacoast-boat-launch-ramps and /guides/piscataqua-river-boating-tides.

confirmed.description: Only yards with a confirmed winter storage price

name: find_yards

winterStoragePrice.description: Yard-confirmed winter storage price. status 'unconfirmed' or 'unavailable' means value is null: Boat Day never fills a default.
